ux_rationale: Phase 2 is a backend/persistence phase (Convex handlers). Composer UI and preview are Phase 3; end-to-end + manual acceptance are Phase 4 / UMV. No browser UX review is applicable.

findings.summary: LifecycleResult.status returned persisted DB status (review, archived) instead of teacher-facing status (submitted, rejected) required by FR5. Phase 3 UI needs teacher-facing status for badges and edit-after-reject surfacing.
findings.resolution: Added TeacherFacingStatus union type, toTeacherFacingStatus() mapping function, and teacherFacingStatus + rejectionComment fields to LifecycleResult. All lifecycle handlers return the new fields. 38 tests pass.

findings.summary: LifecycleResult DTO did not surface rejection/needs_changes comment from the reviewer. Phase 3 UI needs this to display feedback to the teacher.
findings.resolution: Added optional rejectionComment field to LifecycleResult. reviewAuthoredLessonHandler populates it for rejected/needs_changes decisions.

notes: The status mapping is the critical Phase 2→Phase 3 contract gap. Without teacherFacingStatus, Phase 3 UI would display raw DB statuses ("review" instead of "submitted", "archived" instead of "rejected") which violates FR5 ("teachers see status"). The fix adds a pinned mapping function as the single source of truth, new DTO fields, and dedicated tests. The rejection comment was also missing from the DTO (stored only on component_reviews rows), which would force Phase 3 to make extra queries to surface feedback. Both are now resolved. The internal/public Convex wrapper surface is consistent (all mutations use internalMutation, all args validators are stable). No package boundary violations.
